fit: Parkinson mixed menu and composite motor examination
assessment: Shared diet in 16 patients includes cantaloupe. Supplement S2 and body Figure 4 score composite motor change. No fruit-level contrast, preparation or separate tremor estimate.

fit: pooled cucurbit intake and occurrence of Parkinson disease
assessment: Same cohort as PMID23661325. Adjusted occurrence RR 1.00 (95% CI 0.72–1.38) combines four cucurbits. The indication is diagnosis occurrence and there is no separate raw-fruit comparison.

fit: melon SOD extract and stress-model cognition
assessment: GliSODin favored memory in the restraint stress experiment. The supplemented mice were assessed for spatial learning and tissue endpoints.
A ripe pickling-melon versus muskmelon juice contrast concerns glycemia in people with diabetes. Neither a resting-tremor nor isolated raw flesh effect was reported.

fit: cultivar seed extracts, general behavior and rotating rod
assessment: Table 5 has a dose- and time-dependent pattern of rotarod means. Methods describe falls and the table gives time. Table 1 describes general behavior depression with no tremor item.

fit: aqueous muskmelon peel and two motor proxies
assessment: Table 3 gives shorter rotarod retention and Table 4 higher actophotometer activity. The abstract characterizes the rotarod as improved. The exposure is rind extract.

fit: unripe melon landrace crossover and consumer survey
assessment: Crossover exposes volunteers to servings of separate unripe melon landraces or cucumber. Measured appetite and food reward without a tremor assessment.

fit: traditional sweating ingredient and separate tremor term
assessment: Mahlouji lists historical tremor and melon together only at the review level in separate tables. The Dadmehr textual analysis concerns a broader condition. Shared textual sources are plausible and no independent first-person response is established.
Rock melon is a named exposure in a registered crossover. Planned outcomes are glycemic index and load, and as of the review no results were available.

fit: melon-derived SOD capsule and frailty protocol
assessment: The capsule protocol lists frailty and quality-of-life outcomes. Registry results are absent and a named raw-fruit or resting-tremor comparison is not planned.

fit: melon enzyme capsule, non-Parkinson mobility and fatigue
assessment: In mobility-limited older women, motor and fatigue differences are inconclusive. Capsules contain a Vauclusien melon extract and wheat gliadin.

fit: melon concentrate, fatigue and exercise outcomes
assessment: Healthy men trained during a human supplement trial. The dried melon concentrate comparison did not give a clear between-group physical-fatigue difference or a separate tremor outcome.

fit: healthy adult concentrate trial and companion registration
assessment: A 61-participant healthy-adult comparison registered as NCT01767922 reports stress and fatigue. The proprietary freeze-dried concentrate and its endpoints cannot inform the frozen tremor outcome.
Table 1 lists Cucumis melo under a broader historical condition with unspecified plant part and no firsthand response. Preserve as a companion to the Persian textual lineage.
